description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a subclass of Fragment that encapsulates a LogView for displaying log output within an Android application. It manages UI setup including a ScrollView containing a LogView, configures visual properties, and updates the scroll position when log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates and manages a LogView inside a ScrollView to display log data, with setup for UI appearance and behavior.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding, and returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate views, set up a TextWatcher for automatic scrolling on log updates, and return the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
